& \cos A+\cos B=m \\
& \sin A+\sin B=n

$\begin{aligned}
& m n=\sin \mathrm{A} \cdot \cos \mathrm{~A}+\sin \mathrm{A} \cdot \cos \mathrm{~B} \\
& \quad+\quad \cos \mathrm{A} \cdot \sin \mathrm{~B}+\cos \mathrm{B} \cdot \sin \mathrm{~B} \\
& =\frac{\sin 2 \mathrm{~A}}{2}+\sin (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B})+\frac{\sin 2 \mathrm{~B}}{2} \\
& =\sin (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B})+\frac{1}{2}\{2 \sin (\mathrm{~A}+\mathrm{B}) \cdot \cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})\} \\
& =\sin (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B})+\sin (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B}) \cdot \cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B}) \\
& m n=\sin (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B})\{1+\cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})\}...(i)
\end{aligned}$
Also, 
$\begin{aligned} m^2+n^2= & \cos ^2 \mathrm{~A}+\cos ^2 \mathrm{~B} \\ & +2 \cos \mathrm{~A} \cdot \cos \mathrm{~B}+ \\ + & \sin ^2 \mathrm{~A}+\sin ^2 \mathrm{~B} \\ & +2 \sin \mathrm{~A} \cdot \sin \mathrm{~B}\end{aligned}\begin{aligned}
& =2+2 \cos (\mathrm{~A}-\mathrm{B}) \\
& m^2+n^2=2\{1+\cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})\} \\
& \frac{m^2+n^2}{2}=1+\cos (\mathrm{A}-\mathrm{B})...(ii)
\end{aligned}$
From (i) and (ii)
$\sin (\mathrm{A}+\mathrm{B})=\frac{2 m n}{m^2+n^2}$

questions.q: $P Q R S$ is a parallelogram, where $\overrightarrow{P Q}=3 \hat{i}+2 \hat{j}-m \hat{k}$, $\overrightarrow{P S}=\hat{i}+3 \hat{j}+\hat{k}$ and the area of the parallelogram is $\sqrt{90}$. What is the value of $m$ ?
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & \text { Area of parallelogram }=\frac{1}{2}|(\overrightarrow{\mathrm{PQ}} \times \overrightarrow{\mathrm{PS}})| \\ & \therefore \sqrt{90}=\left|\begin{array}{ccc}\hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 3 & 2 & -m \\ 1 & 3 & 1\end{array}\right| \\ & =[\hat{i}(2+3 m)-\hat{j}(3+m)+\hat{k}(9-2)] \\ & \sqrt{90}=\sqrt{(2+3 m)^2+(3+m)^2+49} \\ & =\sqrt{4+12 m+9 m^2+9+m^2+6 m+49} \\ & \sqrt{90}=\sqrt{10 m^2+18 m+62}\end{aligned}\begin{aligned} & \sqrt{90}=\sqrt{10 m^2+18 m+62} \\ \Rightarrow & 10 m^2+18 m+62-90=0 \\ \Rightarrow & 10 m^2+18 m-28=0 \\ \Rightarrow & 5 m^2+9 m-14=0 \\ \Rightarrow & 5 m^2-5 m+14 m-14=0 \\ & 5 m(m-1)+14(m-1)=0 \\ & m-\frac{14}{5}, m=1\end{aligned}$
